# Tests that fail on Android and are understood.  A failure whose
# "directory/file.m:line" appears here does not fail the build; anything else
# does.  Each entry is a test assumption that does not hold on Android rather
# than a defect in gnustep-base.
#
# The XSLT test reads whatever GNUmakefile is in the working directory.
# gnustep-tests generates one during a normal run and this runner does not.
GSXML/basic.m:179
#
# gzip level 9 is asserted to be smaller than level 5.  It is not, for this
# input, with the zlib on the device.
NSData/additions.m:49
#
# Tilde expansion for the current user, which the suite runs as root.
NSString/tilde.m:48
#
# testcat with no arguments is expected to produce output.
NSTask/launch.m:54
#
# /usr does not exist on Android, so the file URL for it is not what the test
# expects.
NSURL/basic.m:155
NSURL/basic.m:157
